devai/2.7.1

Usage: devai init bind [options]

Bind the installed DEVAI package contracts into an adopter repository.

Lifecycle: supported
Authority: mesh_controller
Effects: local-write

Options:
  --target <path>                   Target directory (default: .)
  --tier <tier>                     Adoption tier persisted in project.json: tier1 | tier2 | tier3
  --full                            Run constitution, operational-law, subprocess-effects, and authority-policy binding in order.
  --constitution                    Bind the installed Constitution text and digest pin.
  --subprocess-effects              Bind subprocess-effects policy into .devai/config with byte identity.
  --operational-law                 Bind current operational policies into .devai/config with byte identity.
  --adopter-policy <path>           Validate and bind an Architect-owned policy source under law/policy.
  --host-adapter <adapter>          Bind a verified host adapter: post-merge | github-actions
  --tracking-adapter <adapter>      Bind the opt-in governance tracking capability: github-issues
  --tracking-repository <owner/name>  Exact remote repository the tracking binding authorizes
  --review-authority-policy         Review exact absent authority policy bytes before create.
  --after-constitution              Project the installed Constitution binding for review.
  --as-role <role>                  Declare the initiating human role for this invocation.
  --authority-session <id>          Use a live repository-bound authority session instead of --as-role.
  --write                           Authorize local mutation.
  --format <format>                 Output format when supported: json or human.
